scope: every live required-mode decision rebuilt from original source; grants/reservations/physical cargo/actions causally matched; no graph-network or latency certification

metadata.disturbance_contract: integer-second boundary; circular 2-D envelope; bounded stop/retime
metadata.occupancy: empty hardware traversable; full trip plus persistent terminal body validated before commit
metadata.sampling: all actual business events; complete 100-agent states every 300s plus disturbance/final boundaries

assumptions.chargingPower: configurable shared power budget; 100 bays does not imply unlimited power
assumptions.emptyDockTraversal: allowed only when time-dependent robot/docking occupancy is clear
assumptions.homeAliases: 100 homes alias the 100 docks, not 100 extra parking spaces
assumptions.occupiedDockCollision: real robot body, including fully charged standby
assumptions.workingModel: fixed racks, self pick/place; no new finite workstation device

requires: map adapter without fixed 60x48 / 24 docks / .6m slot pitch
dynamic robot occupancy instead of static dock/home rectangles
